description: data-api request layer, graph endpoint and reports metrics, scraped from GET /metrics. Reference: data-api docs/metrics.md.

panels.title: Scrape status
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape GET /metrics. Down usually means a wrong METRICS_TOKEN (401) or a host missing from ALLOWED_HOSTS (400).

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: All requests except the scrape itself.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(datapi_http_requests_total{job="data-api", route=~"$route", pid=~"$pid", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(datapi_http_requests_total{job="data-api", route=~"$route", pid=~"$pid"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Oldest queued run
panels.description: Age of the oldest report run still queued. A growing value means data-reporter is not claiming work.

panels.title: Collector errors (1h)
panels.description: Scrapes where the reports gauges could not be computed; those gauges were missing for that scrape.

panels.title: Latency percentiles
panels.description: Across the selected routes, from the first middleware to the response.

panels.title: Requests by project
panels.description: JWT traffic only. Management and rejected requests carry no project.

panels.title: Error codes
panels.description: Machine-readable codes from error responses; one count per distinct code per response.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (route, code, pid) (increase(datapi_http_error_codes_total{job="data-api", route=~"$route", pid=~"$pid"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Average graph time by project
panels.description: Time after validation, for requests that found their table.

targets.expr: sum by (pid) (rate(datapi_graph_request_seconds_sum{job="data-api", pid=~"$pid"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pid) (rate(datapi_graph_request_seconds_count{job="data-api", pid=~"$pid"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Query time p95 by aggregation
panels.description: One TimescaleDB query per requested series.

panels.title: Buckets requested
panels.description: (to - from) / bucket_width. The red line is the validator's 5000 cap.

panels.title: Series per request
panels.description: The red line is the validator's 20 cap.

panels.title: Points returned
panels.description: Points in one response, summed over its series.

panels.title: Requested range
panels.description: to - from of one graph request.

panels.title: Job definitions
panels.description: Catalogue entries mirrored from the external catalogue.

panels.title: Runs by state
panels.description: Every transition belongs to data-reporter; data-api only reads the queue.

panels.title: Schedule status changes
panels.description: Surface: api is the owner via JWT, manage is an operator.

panels.title: Runs enqueued
panels.description: outcome=existing on run_now is the idempotent 200 for a period already queued.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Seconds of CPU per second; 1.0 is one full core.

title: Data API
